name: Background jobs
summary: Redis-backed job queue (BullMQ). createQueue(name).add(jobName, data) from the web app; put processors in src/workers/*.js (export queue and process) and run `node src/worker.js` as a separate worker service.

features: - **Background jobs**: BullMQ queues on Redis; run `node src/worker.js` as a second service to process `src/workers/*.js`

env.description: Jobs a worker processes at once (default 5)
